channel.title: The Mutapa Times — Daily Zimbabwe Weather + Tsumo
channel.description: Daily weather forecast for Zimbabwe's main cities plus the Tsumo yezuva (proverb of the day). One item per day, dedicated for the Mutapa Times weather autolist.

item.title: Zim weather 16 Nov: Harare heavy showers · high 28° / low 18°
item.description: Harare: high 28°, low 18° (heavy showers) · Bulawayo: high 31°, low 19° (light showers) · Mutare: high 28°, low 18° (light drizzle) · Gweru: high 30°, low 18° (light drizzle) · Masvingo: high 31°, low 19° (light drizzle) · Victoria Falls: high 34°, low 21° (light drizzle) Tsumo yezuva: Zvikoni zvikoni mimba haibvi negosoro. (Some things have no simple solution.) #Zimbabwe #Weather #ZimbabweWeather #ZimbabweNews
